flows.name: An AI security engineer learns a system, plans with the team, and fixes real risks (Trent AI)
flows.summary: Trent AI's home page, in its own three steps: understand, plan, secure. "Autonomous or human in the loop: your call."

steps.what: Learns the system: code, infrastructure, configs and agents, read in one pass, into one picture of real risks.
steps.agent: Reads and models the whole system.

steps.what: Writes the rules together, mapped to the frameworks the team answers to; the team chooses autonomous or human in the loop.
Finds the real risk as attack chains, not alert lists.

steps.actor: Trent AI with the team's coding agents
steps.what: Fixes it, every fix verified, with a full audit trail.
steps.agent: Fixes through the coding agents the team already uses.
